info.title: API.SH: The New York Times
info.description: The The New York Times API from API.SH: public The New York Times data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: New York Times Best Sellers list
get.description:
One New York Times Best Sellers list for the current week or any past week: `name`, `published_date`, `previous_date`, `next_date` and each book's `rank`, `rank_last_week`, `weeks_on_list`, `title`, `author`, `publisher`, `description`, `isbn13`, `isbn10`, `image`, `review_url`, `buy_links` and `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nytimes-best-sellers

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: List name, e.g. `hardcover-fiction`, `hardcover-nonfiction`, `combined-print-and-e-book-fiction` (default), `paperback-nonfiction`, `young-adult-hardcover`; all names in `/nytimes/v1/best-sellers/overview`.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: List week (YYYY-MM-DD, 2008 or later); the current list when omitted.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Articles from The New York Times archive (1851 to today) matching a query and the site search's filters: date range, section, type of material (News, Op-Ed, Review, Obituary...), news desk and author. Each article: `id`, `url`, `headline`, `print_headline`, `kicker`, `summary`, `snippet`, `lead_paragraph`, `byline`, `published`, `updated`, `section`, `subsection`, `news_desk`, `type_of_material`, `word_count`, `print_section`, `print_page`, `keywords` (people, organizations, places and subjects), `image`, `images`, `timesmachine_url`, `paywalled` and `raw`; article text beyond the lead paragraph is not included. 10 per page, up to page 100. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nytimes-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words (optional when a filter is given).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
